description: False-color infrared satellite map depicting Green urban areas in Täby, Sweden. The map displays a coastal landscape, with a dark blue body of water on the upper right. Land cover is shown in false-color infrared imagery, where healthy vegetation appears bright red, impervious surfaces and buildings are light blue/cyan, and roads are grey with bright yellow double outlines. Yellow lines delineate various land cover polygons. A prominent polygon, encompassing multiple buildings and surrounding red-vegetated areas, is labelled "1400" in green text. This "1400" polygon represents a 'Green urban area', consistent with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) level 2 class 1.4, 'Artificial non-agricultural vegetated areas'. No scale bar, compass, or legend is visible.
